name: Sabine Rourke
source_profile:
Major Sabine Rourke: “The Widowmaker” (NE) 
During the civil war, Major Sabine Rourke commanded one of 
the north's most effective cavalry formations. Her lightning 
raids on royal supply trains earned her a reputation for 
brilliance, recklessness, and extraordinary cruelty toward 
captured officers. After the war, she led the survivors of her 
regiment into the eastern plains, where they turned their 
considerable 
skills 
toward 
horse 
theft, 
cattle rustling, 
stagecoach-style caravan robberies, and mercenary work. 
Major Sabine Rourke of the Red Reins once believed sincerely 
in northern independence, only to watch her noble commanders surrender and negotiate 
pardons while ordinary cavalrymen were left destitute. She now considers the war finished and 

has no particular interest in restoring the northern nobility. Her soldiers fought for their lords, lost 
everything, and now intend to take whatever the world owes them. 
Reputation: Rourke is widely regarded as the finest outlaw horsewoman in the eastern frontier. 
Her gang is notorious for stealing horses directly out of guarded noble stables. 
Adventure hook: The Red Reins steal a valuable herd of warhorses belonging to Marquis 
Garrus Ashford. A handsome bounty is offered for Rourke's capture, but several other parties 
are secretly interested in acquiring the horses.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 35–36 (source excerpt)
